posts.title: Peter Pan-Cakes
posts.post: I just held a Peter Pan-themed pancake breakfast for the residents of the University of North Alabama! It was a magical experience filled with fun, laughter, and of course, delicious pancakes. It was wonderful to see everyone come together and enjoy the event. I can't wait to plan the next one!

posts.post: I just updated my resume to include recent job experience.

posts.title: Raspberry Pi Datacenter
posts.post: Over the course of the Spring-2025 semester I worked with a few other CSIS undergraduates on a Raspberry Pi Datacenter. I had a lot of fun working on this project outside of class, and it taught me a lot of new things. For example, this was the first time I worked with Linux, as I am more familiar with Windows software. Despite the challenges, I was eventually able to have a working Nintendo GameBoy emulator on my Raspberry Pi. I hope to work on more projects similar to this in the future!

posts.title: Should Companies Continue to Push AI Art?
posts.post: The use of Artificial Intelligence is becoming more widespread day by day. Nowadays, you can't do anything without seeing something made from AI. Media made by AI is often given bad reviews, and companies that decide to use AI receive huge amounts of backlash. For example, Coca-Cola made a short Christmas commercial with AI back in December 2024. The responses to it were anything but good, with many feeling upset and betrayed by a company that they used to respect. Do you think companies should continue to push the use of AI with the growing bad reputation it has?
